metric: top-1 cosine similarity against the committed corpus
note: Regenerate with `npm run calibrate`. These are real measurements, not fixtures invented to fit the threshold. tests/threshold.calibration.test.js asserts MATCH_THRESHOLD separates the two bands below, so a future threshold change that reintroduces overlap fails in CI without needing an API key.
